description: Organize, extract, prune, and verify Claude Code persistent memory files. Covers MEMORY.md as a concise index, topic extraction to dedicated files, staleness detection, accuracy verification against project state, the dual 200-line / 25KB load cap, and reachability of topic files from the index. Use when MEMORY.md is approaching either load cap, after a session produces durable insights worth preserving, when a topic section has grown beyond 10-15 lines and should be extracted, when project state has changed and memory entries may be stale, or before and after rewriting the index so that no topic file loses its only pointer.
